stories.title: Six sheep die after being chased by dog on Cilcain Mountain
stories.summary: Six sheep have died on Cilcain Mountain after being chased and cornered by a dog, North Wales Police has said. stories.title: Power cut hits part of Mancot and Aston with supply due back by 2pm
stories.summary: Part of Mancot and Aston is without power this morning after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 2pm. stories.title: Land the size of 26 football pitches can now be bought for new A494 bridge at Queensferry
stories.summary: Land the size of about 26 football pitches in Queensferry, Sealand and Holywell can now be bought by the Welsh Government for the new A494 River Dee bridge, whether the owners want to sell or not. stories.title: Flintshire schools go into the red for the first time as 169 posts are not replaced
stories.summary: Flintshire’s schools did not replace 169 posts last year as they ran up a combined deficit of £3.48m, a council report says. stories.title: Rare greater one-horned rhino born on camera at Chester Zoo
stories.summary: A greater one-horned rhino calf has been born at Chester Zoo, with CCTV cameras recording the birth.
